answer: A sybil farmer's puppets cost nothing to spawn, but judgment cannot be cloned. Make reciprocal review labor the price of eligibility: each epoch every identity must review peers' answers, spot-graded by auditors. Template reviews fail; a controller mass-producing reviews betrays itself through correlated phrasing and score patterns, while auditors earn a cut of forfeited weight. Like a gale stripping a tundra bare, correlation exposes the farm — each review covers novel content no template anticipates, so per-puppet cost converges on honest effort, the oasis the network pays for.
